CLIC_alloy_snapshot.comment:
Locally composed approved qualified reference. Latest typed decisions supersede historical inactive/pending labels below. Source rights and permission to release all cited material remain unverified; no restricted process inventories copied. Current PSI equivalence, connected 3.12 exports, protected PV closure and export/restore validation required before release.

Source history:
Implemented Crofer-type interconnect with integrated partial La production; 8976.1 kg plate and rolling preserved. Scientific gaps: La reject fate and fluoride/PFC/bath coverage remain unimplemented; no inert La disposal is adopted. Native uncertain 18/8 rolling makeup remains intact.

Conditional C165 retained-interconnect alloy improvement, not an approved CLIC manufacturing model or publication authority. The source's APPROVED label is provenance, not a CLIC decision. Preserve the existing8976.1kg reference and its unchanged8976.1kg chromium-steel sheet-rolling service. The selected Crofer22APU-type feed recipe is an engineering analogue within VDM4146rev01 ranges, not an actual heat assay or verified industrial-MW stack geometry. Its0.7708kg unalloyed-steel feed is not pure elemental Fe, and unlisted impurities are not proven absent. No intentional alloy Ni addition does not establish nickel-free manufacture. The native rolling service still purchases0.0516kg18/8 loss-makeup stock perkg service, or 463.16676kg nominal perstack; retain that explicitly imperfect proxy and its native uncertainty. Never cancel it using a fixed negative steel input or silently remove its uncertainty. Generic steel working/hot rolling also include stock, while a stock-free direct deep-drawing reference is not an equivalent sheet-rolling operation. Remelting0.5kWh+2MJ/kg,100% final alloy retention, unquantified plant/slag/freight, and La oxide electrolysis95%retention with10kWh+3MJ/kg remain explicit assumptions, not manufacturer LCI. The latter net reaction is integrated at0.001kgLa perkg alloy in the same GLO process location, with every source leaf flow and its nominal amount preserved; no separate generic La dataset is introduced. Bath makeup, purification and possible electrolysis emissions remain unquantified, not proven zero. Preserve electrode Ni, ceramics, glass/LSM placeholders, electricity, lifetime and every unrelated source exchange in the existing stack. This does not admit neighbouring held models, grade-specific forming or alloy-specific end-of-life. No new recovery credit, native inventory change or stored background migration.

Nomenclature revision, 2026-10-19. Former activity name: ferritic interconnect steel, Crofer22APU-type engineering reference. Former reference product: ferritic interconnect steel, Crofer22APU-type engineering reference. Activity/product labels and supplier references only; coefficients, formulas, uncertainty, declared output and unit are unchanged. Original engineering assumptions, functional-unit basis and limitations remain below.

APPROVED SOEC FERRITIC INTERCONNECT REFERENCE, issue95, 2026-10-18. Hafele2016 DOI10.1016/j.ijhydene.2016.05.069 SI FigS1:chromiumsteelplate->deepdrawing+LSMcoating->interconnect; main stackdescription2outer3kg and4inner145g plates. Gerloff2021 PtM SI pS16 retains8976.1kg18/8steel but labels air-electrode. VDM Crofer22APU datasheet4146rev01 March2022 Table2 andApplications p5 explicitly SOEC interconnects/bipolarplates:Cr20-24wt%,Mn0.30-0.80,Ti0.03-0.20,La0.04-0.20,Fe balance. https://www.vdm-metals.com/fileadmin/user_upload/Downloads/Data_Sheets/Data_Sheet_VDM_Crofer_22_APU.pdf . Sourceflow8976.1kg is treated as the interconnectplate package based on originalmanufacturingdiagram,not9tair-electrodecatalyst. AdoptCrofer22APU-type reference for THIS stackinput only; do not replace ordinaryBoP18/8heat exchangers. Preserve8976.1kgfinishedsteel and8976.1kgexistingrollingservice; mass derives labstackscaleup and is NOT independently validated industrialMWgeometry. Preserve priorLSM,PrNi,ceramics,stackreplacement andlearning. Reference alloy massfractions={'Cr': 0.22, 'Mn': 0.005, 'Ti': 0.001, 'La': 0.001, 'Si': 0.001, 'Al': 0.0005, 'Cu': 0.0005, 'C': 0.0001, 'P': 5e-05, 'S': 5e-05, 'Fe': 0.7708}. Midrange/lowresidual choices are explicit assumptions within publishedranges,not measured heat assay. No intentionalNi addition; unknownresidualNi/othertraceimpurities are NOT provenzero. ActualoldNi8% cannot be claimed quantitatively without suppliercomposition; compareold18/8 as sensitivity. Cr20-24,Mn0.3-0.8,La0.04-0.20wt% sensitivities. Fe usesunalloyedsteel as feed-gradeproxy,withitsownminoralloys unresolved; completecomponentmetaluse is not identical toelementalpureFe. Addalloyingmaterialsonce and0.5kWh+2MJ/kgremeltingreference (0.25-1kWh/1-4MJsensitivity),not a completeCrsteel production dataset on top. Matchfinishedsteelmass1kgwith100%finalalloyretention; alloyingyield/slag andtracepickup remain gaps. La metal unavailable: explicit netoxide/carbon electrolyticreference La2O3+1.5C->2La+1.5CO2,95%metalretention,10kWh/kg+3MJ/kgassumed; fluoridebathmakeup,PFCemissions,purification andcalcium-route alternatives unresolved. Thisisstoichiometricnetelectrolysis,NOTthermal carbothermic reduction orvalidatedvendorLa process. Metalrejectgenericinertdisposal; La/C/O/massclose. FinishedinterconnectEOLexistingsteelcollection amount retained; genericsteelroute doesnotvalidatealloy-specificrecycling orrecoverycredits. Native/YAML/runtime/primary-secondaryshares untouched.
